Excellent opportunity to own a clean, one-owner 25 Gamefish that has been tastefully optioned and well maintained. Finished in a two-tone white and grey gelcoat with powder-coated piping and powered by twin Yamaha 150s with just 103 hours. The 25 Gamefish is the ideal “do it all” boat, with ample seating and storage for comfortable cruising and sandbar days, while offering the features and fishing amenities needed for a day offshore.

Notable Features:

• Twin Yamaha 150s – 103 hours
• Twin Garmin 8600 12” electronics with autopilot
• JL Audio package
• Underwater LED lights
• Marine head
• Fresh and saltwater washdowns
• Side entry dive door

• Leaning post with livewell and captain’s chairs
• Transom livewell

Easy to show by appointment only in Palmetto Bay, FL.

GeneralBoatDescription:
2022 Yellowfin 42 Offshore

Unique opportunity to acquire one of the last Wylie Nagler-built Yellowfin 42 Offshores in pristine condition. Owned by a multiple-Yellowfin owner, this 42 has been thoughtfully outfitted with everything you need and nothing you don’t.

Finished in a super-clean Ice Blue and powered by the highly desirable triple Yamaha 425 XTOs with less than 150 hours, this particular 42 Offshore has been lightly used, always lift-kept, and exceptionally well cared for.

Highlights include dual Garmin 8624 displays, 12kW open-array radar, dual-row seating, new custom upholstery, cabin A/C, bow thruster, solid-glass windshield, Gemlux carbon outriggers, side dive door, aft bait station with refrigerator, and a massive JL Audio system.

A rare opportunity to own a low-hour, properly equipped 42 Offshore with the right power, options, and ownership history.

Notable Features & Equipment:

  • Triple Yamaha 425 XTO outboards with less than 150 hours (under warranty)

  • Dual Garmin 8624 MFD

  • Garmin 12kW open-array radar

  • Dual-row helm seating

  • New custom upholstery

  • Solid-glass windshield

  • Bow thruster

  • Air-conditioned cabin

  • Massive JL Audio sound system

  • Gemlux carbon-fiber outriggers

  • Side dive door

  • Aft bait station

  • Aft refrigerator

With extremely low hours, warranty remaining on her Yamaha 425 XTOs, and a desirable combination of fishing and cruising options, this represents a turn-key opportunity for a buyer looking for one of the premier large center consoles on the market.

Showings available by appointment only in Naples, FL.

GeneralBoatDescription:
2020 Cruisers 38 GLS Outboard

The 38 GLS combines the bold styling and performance of the Cantius series with the versatility of outboard power. Designed for both adventure and comfort, this yacht features a unique fold-down beach door that expands your swim platform and offers unmatched water access. Below deck, the spacious cabin includes a private aft stateroom and a U-shaped dinette that easily converts into an additional berth. Whether you're entertaining dockside or cruising offshore, this 2020 38 GLS delivers a premium yachting experience with style, performance, and comfort. Her current owner has his sights set on a new vessel and is offering this 2020 38 GLS at a fraction of its replacement cost. 

Notable features include:

- (3) Mercury V8 Verado 300 

- Mercury JPO Joystick and Autopilot 

- Seakeeper Equipped

- Dual Simrad EVO Displays 

- Simrad Closed Array Radar 

- Exterior Wet Bar with Stools 

- Canvas Sunroof

- Folding Beach Door 

- Helm A/C

- Cockpit Grill

- Cockpit Refrigeration

- Cockpit Seating with Tables 

- Rockford Fosgate Audio 

- Custom Upholstery Covers 

Conveniently located and available for showings in Coral Gables, FL.

2018 Invincible 40 Catamaran

Motivated Seller - Offers Encouraged

Offered by a knowledgeable, multi-boat owner and professionally captain maintained since new, this Invincible 40 Cat represents one of the best values currently available in the catamaran center console market. Finished in a timeless Whisper Grey and White color scheme, she boasts an impressive Garmin electronics package, recent upgrades and updates throughout, and a level of care that's immediately evident from the moment you step aboard.

Whether your mission is offshore fishing, cruising the islands, or entertaining family and friends, this Invincible 40 Cat is equipped to do it all. Fresh off a recent yard period, all preventative maintenance is up to date making this vessel ready for immediate delivery. 

Notable Features Include:

  • Quad Mercury 350 Verados
  • Brand-new upholstery throughout
  • New Starlink Satellite Internet
  • Extensive Garmin electronics suite featuring:
    • (2) Garmin GPSMAP 8622 multifunction displays

  • Premium JL Audio system
  • Gemlux carbon fiber outriggers with Gemlux bases
  • Side dive door
  • Removable aft bench seating
  • Custom covers
  • 4 electric reel plugs 

Conveniently located in Coral Gables, Florida, this exceptional Invincible 40 Catamaran is available for private showings by appointment only.

This 2016 Boston Whaler 420 Outrage is a well-equipped example of one of Boston Whaler’s most versatile offshore platforms. Finished in an aristo blue hull and powered by quad Mercury 350 Verados , she combines serious offshore capability with the comfort and amenities of even the highest pedigree cabin cruisers. She is currently the only 2016 420 Outrage on the market with a seakeeper.
